description: This source file defines an abstract base class for actors that perform health checks on subsystems within an Akka actor system. It manages health status retrieval and updates, and handles messaging related to health status requests.

classes.name: AbstractHealthCheckingActor
classes.description: Abstract base class for health-checking actors using Akka, providing mechanisms to retrieve, update, and notify about subsystem health status.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the main message handling flow by combining health retrieval, custom messages, and catch-all.

methods.name: matchCustomMessages
methods.description: Abstract method for handling custom messages specific to subclasses.

methods.name: triggerHealthRetrieval
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to initiate health status retrieval.

methods.name: updateHealth
methods.description: Updates the health status and notifies all waiting receivers.

methods.name: matchRetrieveHealth
methods.description: Creates a Receive block to handle RetrieveHealth message.

methods.name: matchAny
methods.description: Handles unknown messages by logging warnings.

methods.name: retrieveHealth
methods.description: Adds the sender to waitlist and triggers health retrieval.
